info.title: kitchen-ops API
info.description: Purchasing and stock control. Sign-in, sign-out and 2FA are Better Auth's routes under /api/auth, not described here.

get.summary: The API is up, and which build is running

patch.summary: Change the signed-in user's own settings: their language

get.summary: The audit log: every write, newest first, filtered and paged
Storerooms, by name: searched, by type and status, a page at a time

patch.summary: Change a storeroom, or deactivate it

get.summary: Suppliers, by name: searched by name or tax ID, by status, a page at a time

post.summary: Add a supplier, with a Spanish tax ID that passes its checksum

patch.summary: Change a supplier, or deactivate it

get.summary: Products, by name, with their conversions: searched, by category, storeroom and status, a page at a time

post.summary: Add a product, with its unit conversions

patch.summary: Change a product or its conversions, or deactivate it; its base unit never changes

get.summary: Supplier products, by description: searched by code or description, by supplier, product and status, a page at a time

post.summary: Add how a supplier names and packs one of our products

get.summary: One supplier product, with its pack in base units

patch.summary: Change a supplier product, or deactivate it

post.summary: Upload a document: one PDF or Facturae file, or up to 10 photos of it, in order

documentType.description: delivery-note for a delivery note (albarán); invoice for an invoice (factura), including credit notes (facturas rectificativas), whose amounts are negative.

name.description: The supplier's legal name, as printed with its tax ID: the company name or the person's full name, never a brand, logo or trade name. null if not printed.

taxId.description: The supplier's tax ID (NIF or CIF), in upper case, without spaces, dots or hyphens: "B-12.345.678" is "B12345678". Keep a country prefix such as ES if printed. null if not printed.

number.description: The document number, as printed. null if not printed.

issueDate.description: The issue date, as YYYY-MM-DD. null if not printed.

deliveryNotes.description: The numbers of the delivery notes (albaranes) the document says it bills, each as printed, in the order printed. An invoice often lists them in its header, in its notes, or above each group of lines. Empty if it lists none, and on a delivery note.

net.description: The total before VAT, in euros. Text, with a point as the decimal separator and no thousands separator: "1.234,56" on the document is "1234.56". null if not printed.

rate.description: The VAT rate. "21" for 21%. null if not printed.

base.description: The taxable base at this rate, in euros. Text, with a point as the decimal separator and no thousands separator: "1.234,56" on the document is "1234.56". null if not printed.

amount.description: The VAT at this rate, in euros. Text, with a point as the decimal separator and no thousands separator: "1.234,56" on the document is "1234.56". null if not printed.

items.description: One row of the VAT breakdown: one per rate.

vat.description: The VAT breakdown, one row per rate. Empty if not printed.

total.description: The total to pay, including VAT, in euros. Text, with a point as the decimal separator and no thousands separator: "1.234,56" on the document is "1234.56". null if not printed.

totals.description: The document's totals. null when it shows no prices, as some delivery notes don't.

supplierCode.description: The supplier's own code for the product. null if not printed.

description.description: The product, as printed on the line. null if not printed.

quantity.description: The quantity, in the line's unit. Negative for returns. Text, with a point as the decimal separator and no thousands separator: "1.234,56" on the document is "1234.56". null if not printed.

unit.description: The unit, as printed: kg, caja, ud, botella… null if not printed.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit, as printed: before discount, excluding VAT. Text, with a point as the decimal separator and no thousands separator: "1.234,56" on the document is "1234.56". null if not printed.

discountPercent.description: The line discount (the "Dto." column) as a percentage. "21" for 21%. null if not printed.

vatRate.description: The VAT rate that applies to this line. "21" for 21%. null if not printed.

lineTotal.description: The line total, as printed: after discount, excluding VAT. Text, with a point as the decimal separator and no thousands separator: "1.234,56" on the document is "1234.56". null if not printed.

items.description: One product line.

lines.description: Every product line, in the order printed. Not subtotal, VAT or total rows.

name.description: The supplier's legal name, as printed with its tax ID: the company name or the person's full name, never a brand, logo or trade name. null if not printed.

taxId.description: The supplier's tax ID (NIF or CIF), in upper case, without spaces, dots or hyphens: "B-12.345.678" is "B12345678". Keep a country prefix such as ES if printed. null if not printed.

number.description: The document number, as printed. null if not printed.

issueDate.description: The issue date, as YYYY-MM-DD. null if not printed.

deliveryNotes.description: The numbers of the delivery notes (albaranes) the document says it bills, each as printed, in the order printed. An invoice often lists them in its header, in its notes, or above each group of lines. Empty if it lists none, and on a delivery note.

net.description: The total before VAT, in euros. Text, with a point as the decimal separator and no thousands separator: "1.234,56" on the document is "1234.56". null if not printed.

rate.description: The VAT rate. "21" for 21%. null if not printed.

total.description: The total to pay, including VAT, in euros. Text, with a point as the decimal separator and no thousands separator: "1.234,56" on the document is "1234.56". null if not printed.

totals.description: The document's totals. null when it shows no prices, as some delivery notes don't.
